title_sq: Shitet, Apartament 2+1+Blk, Ali Demi- Rezidenca Kadiu, 118 000 Euro
description_sq:
Shitet, Apartament 2+1+Blk, Ali Demi- Rezidenca Kadiu, 118 000 Euro
Karakteristika te prones:
– Apartament 2+1
– Rruga Pasho Hysa, Ali Demi
– Rezidenca Kadiu
– Kati 5
– Siperfaqja Bruto 70.3m²
– Siperfaqja Neto 61.8m²
– Çmimi 118 000 Euro
Shitet apartament 2+1 me siperfaqe Bruto 70.3 m², i cili ndodhet ne katin e 5 te nje pallati te ri ne ndertim, i cili perfundon ne 2026. Organizohet ne sallon ndenje, ambient gatimi, 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet dhe ballkoni. Planimetria eshte funksionale dhe e shfrytezueshme maksimalisht dhe me ndricim natyral.
Objekti do te pajiset me ashensor dhe infrastrukture bashkekohore. Ambientet e perbashketa jane te mirembajtura dhe ofrojne komoditet dhe sigurine e nevojshme per banoret. Rezidenca ndodhet ne nje zone ne zhvillim me akses te shpejte ne rrugore kryesore dhe prane faciliteteve kryesore.
Ndertimi eshte realizuar sipas standardeve bashkekohore dhe me materiale cilesore, duke garantuar nje prone te sigurte dhe me vlere te qendrueshme ne kohe.
Prona perfaqeson nje mundesi shume te mire si per banim familjar ashtu edhe per investim.
Nuk shitet me kredi.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
title_en: For sale, Apartment 2+1+Blk, Ali Demi- Rezidenca Kadiu, 118 000 Euro
description_en: For sale, Apartment 2+1+Blk, Ali Demi- Rezidenca Kadiu, 118,000 Euro Property characteristics: – Apartment 2+1 – Pasho Hysa Street, Ali Demi – Kadiu Residence – Floor 5 – Gross area 70.3m² – Net area 61.8m² – Price 118,000 Euros 2+1 apartment for sale with gross area 70.3 m², which is located on the 5th floor of a new building under construction, which will be completed in 2026. It is organized in a living room, a kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and a balcony. The layout is functional and usable to the maximum and with natural lighting. The facility will be equipped with an elevator and contemporary infrastructure. The common premises are well maintained and offer the necessary comfort and safety for the residents. The residence is located in a developing area with quick access to the main road and near the main facilities. The construction was carried out according to contemporary standards and with quality materials, guaranteeing a safe property with lasting value over time. The property represents a very good opportunity for both family residence and investment. Not sold on credit.
